section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Positive psychological processes', describes several scales used to assess cognitive and affective components of empathy, acceptance, and self-compassion. It details the 28-item Interpersonal Reactivity Index (IRI), the 10-item Acceptance and Action Questionnaire-2 (AAQ-2), and the 26-item Self Compassion Scale (SCS), including their subscales, response formats, and what they measure. No specific studies or sample subsets are mentioned.
